acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Host Ira Glass reflects on his feelings about going to the beach.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Producer Dana Chivvis explores the case of a 66-year-old working lifeguard who is suing New York State for age discrimination after refusing to wear a Speedo on the job.
acts.title: Grapes of Wrath

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc:
A troupe of comedians tells personal stories about summer experiences and improvises scenes based on them.
Featuring Mike Birbiglia, John Lutz, Kate Micucci, Shannon O'Neill, Connor Ratliff, Gary Richardson, and Tami Sagher — several of whom appear in Mike's movie Don't Think Twice, produced by Ira.
acts.title: Say Yes to Summer

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Producer Neil Drumming tells the story of his dad and his family’s timeshare in Orlando, Florida.
acts.title: It Takes A Villa
